verdict.rationale: A probe found an llms.txt (HTTP 200) on the AWS documentation domain that hosts the IVS docs, so an agent can be pointed at structured AWS docs that include IVS. However, the file is AWS-wide rather than IVS-specific, and the IVS markdown docs path returned 404, so agent-oriented coverage of IVS itself is unproven. Missing for 10: an IVS-specific llms.txt or confirmed IVS entries in it, markdown or agent-oriented IVS doc pages, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
